description: Code questions whose answers are relationships: interface implementations (Go structural, Rust traits), multi-hop callers, and resolved callees. Balanced: two can be answered with one good grep, two need several hops. Graded by regex with partial credit; answers verified against the pinned commits.

tasks.prompt: How many non-test types in gin's render package implement the render.Render interface, and which types are they? Answer with the count and the list of type names.
tasks.reference: 18: AsciiJSON, BSON, Data, HTML, IndentedJSON, JSON, JsonpJSON, MsgPack, PDF, ProtoBuf, PureJSON, Reader, Redirect, SecureJSON, String, TOML, XML, YAML.

tasks.prompt: Which concrete types in this repository implement the grep-searcher crate's Sink trait? Ignore the blanket impls for &mut S and Box<S>. List the type names.
tasks.reference: UTF8, Lossy, Bytes (grep_searcher::sinks), JSONSink, StandardSink, SummarySink (grep-printer); KitchenSink in test utilities.

tasks.prompt: In gin's non-test Go code, Context.AbortWithStatus is called directly by a few functions. Which non-test functions call one of those direct callers, i.e. reach AbortWithStatus through exactly one intermediate function call? Name them (count calls only, not functions passed as values).
tasks.reference: BindUri, MustBindWith and Negotiate (via AbortWithError). BasicAuth calls BasicAuthForRealm, but the AbortWithStatus call sits in the closure BasicAuthForRealm returns, which the router invokes as a value; answers may include or exclude BasicAuth (grader fixed after transcript review).

tasks.prompt: Which methods defined in flask does Flask.full_dispatch_request (src/flask/app.py) call directly? For each, give the line in src/flask/app.py where that method is defined.
